name: Map Conversion Site Architecture
summary: Map a website around user decisions, content ownership, navigation, and crawlable relationships.
description: Plan or audit a marketing website’s page inventory, hierarchy, navigation, URL system, internal links, and ownership around user decisions and search discovery. Use before a redesign, migration, or expansion when page relationships need an explicit model.
risk_reason: This skill maps a website around user decisions, content ownership, navigation, and crawlable relationships; it does not create pages solely to occupy keywords or mirror the company org chart.
refuses: It does not delete, merge, redirect, or rename production URLs without approved migration evidence.
It does not create pages solely to occupy keywords or mirror the company org chart.
It does not claim a hierarchy is usable or crawlable without appropriate validation.

operational.latency_reason: The skill maps a website around user decisions, content ownership, navigation, and crawlable relationships, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
